title: Diagnosing a Malware Protection or ATP block from the logs

ruletype-column.statement: The web log field ruletype, shown in Web Insights as Blocked Policy Type, names the policy that blocked the transaction and applies only to Block rules. The documented example values are File Type Control, Data Loss Prevention and Sandbox.

quotes: %s{ruletype},"The type of policy. Applies only to Block rules, not Allow.","File Type Control, Data Loss Prevention, Sandbox",Blocked Policy Type

reason-field.statement: The reason field holds the action taken and the policy applied when a transaction was blocked. Its documented examples include 'Virus/Spyware/Malware Blocked' and 'This page is unsafe (high PageRisk index)'.

quotes: %s{reason},"The action that the service took and the policy that was applied, if the transaction was blocked.
This page is unsafe (high PageRisk index)

threat-fields.statement: The threat category of a detection is carried by malwarecat (shown as Threat Category), with threatname for the named threat. urlcat also includes the Advanced Threat Category, listed in the Advanced Threat Category filter of Web Insights.

quotes: %s{malwarecat},"The category of malware that was detected in the transaction, if any.
%s{threatname},"The name of the threat that was detected in the transaction, if any"
Also includes the Advanced Threat Category.

riskscore-field.statement: The riskscore field is the Page Risk Index score of the destination URL, in the range 0 to 100 from lowest to highest risk, so it can be compared with the configured Page Risk tolerance.

quotes: %d{riskscore},"The Page Risk Index score of the destination URL.
The range is 0–100, from the lowest to the highest risk.

security-dashboard.statement: ATP transactions are logged in real time and shown on the Security Dashboard in the Zscaler Admin Console; access to this feature is through the Zscaler Account team.

quotes: The Zscaler service logs transactions in real time and shows the information on the Security Dashboard
Security Dashboard (Analytics > Internet & SaaS > Dashboard > Security) in the Zscaler Admin Console. To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.

ruletype-values.title: Exact ruletype strings for Malware Protection and ATP blocks
ruletype-values.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'MP blocks populate this with Malware Protection; ATP blocks populate it with Advanced Threat Protection (pattern match to the documented examples; confirm on first tenant export).' The sandbox verdicts subject holds the MCP skill's statement that Blocked Policy Type identifies Malware Protection and Advanced Threat Protection. The NSS schema lists only File Type Control, Data Loss Prevention and Sandbox as examples. What would resolve it: a web log export of a known MP and a known ATP block.
ruletype-values.blocks: Writing a log filter on ruletype for these two engines.
